VIDEO SCRIPT: HADITH ON PLANTING
Grade: Grade 6 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Hadith on planting. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
• plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
• appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
• Model 2: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
• Model 3: appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
• Practise: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
• Practise: appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Hadith on planting.”
